name: Sent Antuan Kilisesi
name_en: Church of St. Anthony of Padua
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Grok Bot, 4 Nov 2026) on the OSM outline w112619334 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Figures and sources: data_pipeline/stantoine/README.md; unpublished heights pixel-measured from reference photos (yaklaşık). Present-day state; toy style. Shape references never used as textures.

anchor.what: model origin = OSM outline centroid, courtyard level

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
ground: y = 0 (flat); the map adds terrain height at the anchor only

heights_m.plan: Latin cross pixel-measured from the top-down photo at 5.32 px/m (front->head 266 px = 50 m, sentantuan.com): nave+aisles ≈21 m wide (aisles ≈4.7 m inside, source 4.70 m), nave roof ≈10.3 m, transept 29.20 × ≈12.8 m (length per sentantuan.com; photo gave ≈31.2), head ≈10.7 × 12.6 m with chamfered end (yaklaşık)
heights_m.walls: nave/transept/head walls 19.5 m, aisle walls 13.0 m (inside height 23 m per sentantuan.com; walls yaklaşık)
heights_m.roofs: terracotta tile hipped roofs, ridge ≈24.0 m, crossing as a hip/valley intersection (no dome); aisle roofs to ≈14.3 m; white stone eave trims (photos)
heights_m.front: central gable with the cross at ≈26 m (sentantuan.com: 26 m), aisle fronts ≈15.5 m, pinnacles to ≈25.7 m (pixel, yaklaşık)
heights_m.bell_tower: ≈5.5 m square (top-down, perspective-corrected, yaklaşık) at the rear corner of the head and the right transept arm; shaft to 25.0 m, belfry with arches + clock to 31.0 m, spire tip ≈42.0 m (oblique + axial photos, yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.forecourt: ≈33 m deep paved forecourt between the two Sent Antuan apartment blocks (OSM map buildings, ≈16.6 m), gated three-arch arcade at İstiklal (yaklaşık)
heights_m.site: the ground falls steeply to the east (apse floor 26 m above the street below); the map ground is flat here

parts: Latin-cross red-brick body: nave with two aisles, transept, chamfered head
terracotta tile hipped roofs with white eave trims, crossing as hip/valley intersection
neo-Gothic west front: gables, pinnacles, stone stripes, turquoise frieze, three rose windows, porch, steps
bell tower at the rear corner of head and right transept arm: belfry, clock, pointed tile spire
paved forecourt with gated arcade at İstiklal
footprint_note: map metres; map buildings under it are dropped
